result.explanation: Use the direct conditional rule: before each operation, remove expired entries; a successful put replaces the key, evicting oldest entries until capacity fits, while get refreshes recency. Advance also purges immediately after changing time. A put that exceeds capacity is a no-op.
result.mapping: State maps now and an oldest-to-newest entry list. Each entry stores key, value, size, and expiry. Output derives from the current list, byte sum, time, and get result.
result.assumptions: Expiry exists only for ttl>0; ttl=0 removes the key without insertion. The supplied fields are valid safe integers and event types are valid.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){let c=input.config.capacity,s={n:0,a:[]};let out=[];function p(){s.a=s.a.filter(x=>x[3]>s.n)}function rm(k){s.a=s.a.filter(x=>x[0]!==k)}function emit(v){let b=0;for(let x of s.a)b+=x[2];out.push({value:v,keys:s.a.map(x=>x[0]),bytes:b,now:s.n})}for(let e of input.events){p();if(e.type==='advance'){s.n+=e.dt;p();emit(null)}else if(e.type==='get'){let i=s.a.findIndex(x=>x[0]===e.key),v=null;if(i>=0){let x=s.a[i];v=x[1];s.a.splice(i,1);s.a.push(x)}emit(v)}else{if(e.size<=c){rm(e.key);if(e.ttl>0){let b=0;for(let x of s.a)b+=x[2];while(s.a.length&&b+e.size>c){b-=s.a[0][2];s.a.shift()}s.a.push([e.key,e.value,e.size,s.n+e.ttl])}}emit(null)}}if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==out.length)return false;return JSON.stringify(output)===JSON.stringify(out)}
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,e:[]},n=s.now,a=s.e.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}));function purge(){a=a.filter(x=>x.t>n)}function remove(k){a=a.filter(x=>x.k!==k)}function result(v){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;return{state:{now:n,e:a.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}))},output:{value:v,keys:a.map(x=>x.k),bytes:b,now:n}}}purge();if(event.type==='advance'){n+=event.dt;purge();return result(null)}if(event.type==='get'){let i=a.findIndex(x=>x.k===event.key);if(i<0)return result(null);let x=a[i];a.splice(i,1);a.push(x);return result(x.v)}if(event.size>config.capacity)return result(null);remove(event.key);if(event.ttl>0){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;while(a.length&&b+event.size>config.capacity){b-=a[0].z;a.shift()}a.push({k:event.key,v:event.value,z:event.size,t:n+event.ttl})}return result(null)}
